messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Thank you for the details. Your phone settings look good on the device side - you have excellent signal, 5G network, mobile data enabled, and data roaming enabled.

However, I noticed from your account that you've used 15.1 GB out of your 15.0 GB monthly data limit. When you exceed your plan's data limit, your data connectivity is affected, which would cause slow or non-working data.

Before we address the data limit issue, let me check your APN settings to ensure they're configured correctly for roaming. Please use the **check_apn_settings** command on your phone to see your current APN name and MMSC URL settings.

My current APN settings are: APN name is "internet" and the MMSC URL is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc". What do you suggest I do next?

Please summarize the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
